account.title: Do I need an account?
account.content: No. You can start using the tools directly in the browser.

server.title: Is my content sent to a server?
server.content: The main processing happens locally in the browser while you use the tool.

linkPassword.title: Does the link contain my password?
linkPassword.content: No. Links and QR codes contain only encrypted data and the required public parameters. Share the password separately, preferably through another channel.

mobile.title: Does it work on mobile?
mobile.content: Yes. The screens were organized for mobile use with a direct flow.

contentTypes.title: Can I use it for files, messages, and images?
contentTypes.content: Yes. Each tool was built for a specific task.

firstTool.title: Which tool should I use first?
firstTool.content: If you want to protect a document, start with files. For short messages, use protected QR or protected link.

steganography.title: Is steganography the same as encryption?
steganography.content: No. In steganography, the protected message is hidden inside an image. In encryption, the content is protected directly.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.note: The selection only affects new packages. When recovering, RAM and passes are read directly from the file header.

seguranca_basica.label: Basic security level
seguranca_basica.description: Ideal for entry-level phones. Very fast processing. Offers excellent day-to-day protection, but lower resistance to hardware-focused brute-force attacks.

seguranca_media.label: Medium security level (Recommended)
seguranca_media.description: The balance point. Runs on most modern smartphones and computers and significantly increases the cost of parallel attempts.

seguranca_alta.label: High security level
seguranca_alta.description: Requires a lot of memory and is recommended for computers. It may fail or slow down on phones.

page.title: Create a QR with a password-protected message.
page.description: Write the message, set the password, and generate the QR on a simple and direct screen.
page.invalidHashFallback: Could not interpret the protected message present in the QR URL.

how.title: How it works
how.content: Write the message, set the password, and generate the QR. When a new QR is scanned, the site opens with the message already loaded and you only need to enter the password.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.content: New QRs open the site automatically. Older QRs with the protected text directly still work when you upload the image.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: Everything happens in the browser. No text or image leaves your device, and the password is never included in the QR code. Share it separately.

page.title: Organize multiple notes in an encrypted portable vault.
page.description: Create, search, and organize notes locally, then export them as an Argon2id and AES-256-GCM protected .criptoveu-note file.

how.title: How it works
how.content: On first use, you create a master password. Titles, tags, and text are decrypted only in memory after the vault is unlocked.

saved.title: What stays saved in the browser
saved.content: Only an encrypted NOTE2 envelope with Argon2id, salt, IV, and ciphertext. The PORTABLE_VAULT1 document, titles, tags, and text remain inside the ciphertext. Legacy vaults migrate only after the correct password.

backup.title: Backup and recovery
backup.content: You can export a .criptoveu-note file and import it on the same or another device. Legacy JSON backups remain supported.

forgot.title: If I forget the password
forgot.content: There is no recovery. Store the password separately from the .criptoveu-note file. Backups made before a password change still use the previous password.
